title: Why the Close Door Button Does Nothing
topic: Why the close door button in elevators often does nothing
mechanism: A 1990 disability law makes elevator doors stay open a minimum time the close button cannot cut, so in many lifts it is wired to nothing except the firefighters' key mode, and New York's crosswalk buttons were mostly dead too.

beats.hook: You've hit the close door button six times and the doors haven't moved
beats.story: You're late for a job interview on floor forty
beats.rise: The doors finally slide shut and you're sure your thumb did it
beats.twist: A firefighter steps in, turns a key in the FIRE SERVICE slot and taps the same button: the doors slam shut at once
beats.mechanism: Law book stamped 1990, door timer screen 3 SEC, panel opened: CLOSE wire runs only to the FIRE KEY switch, crosswalk pole PUSH BUTTON, city board 2,500 OF 3,250 DEAD, 1970s signal box, $1 MILLION price tag
beats.ending: Two minutes late on floor forty; back in the lobby a new rider jabs the close button

seed.what: The FIRE SERVICE keyhole on the button panel and the firefighter waiting in the lobby
